principles: A successful deployment is not proof of user-visible behavior.
A claim status does not improve merely because it is repeated.
Each important claim must retain scope, uncertainty, source and revalidation path.

evidence.claim: The legacy public homepage loaded and described requests as pre-confirmation requests.
evidence.limitation: Content fetch, not a complete browser interaction test.

evidence.claim: The legacy health endpoint returned ok=true and storage=available during the previous audit.
evidence.limitation: Does not prove every read/write action or data durability.

evidence.claim: Search and discovery returned 404 on the legacy public alias after rollback.
evidence.limitation: Historical observation; must be re-checked before future production changes.

evidence.claim: The prior stable deployment and latest listed deployment were different IDs.
evidence.limitation: Documents why alias-to-deployment mapping must be recorded.

evidence.claim: Loofy147/La9ta was empty at initial inspection and was populated with an organized source tree.
evidence.limitation: Repository contents evolve; current branch and commit are the source of truth.

evidence.claim: Long source responses from the prior deployment connector were visibly truncated, so they were not treated as canonical source.
evidence.limitation: This repo reconstructs known behavior; it is not a byte-for-byte recovery of the prior source.

evidence.claim: GitHub Actions workflow La9ta CI run #37 completed successfully; syntax check, tests and JSON validation all succeeded.
evidence.limitation: Domain/static contracts; not a security penetration test or complete end-to-end order lifecycle test.

evidence.claim: An independent Node 22 sandbox run of npm run check && npm test returned exit code 0 with 27 tests passing.
evidence.limitation: Does not test a persisted order write/read/update against the runtime.

evidence.claim: A separate Vercel project la9ta is linked to Loofy147/La9ta with root directory src.
evidence.limitation: It is separate from the old dz-pick-store project.

evidence.claim: The branch deployment built as READY from the recorded verification commit.
evidence.limitation: Vercel readiness alone does not prove every route works.

evidence.claim: GET /api/health on the isolated branch deployment returned ok=true and storage=available.
evidence.limitation: A list/availability probe is not an end-to-end order write test.

evidence.claim: Search HOCO H29 returned a relevant result at 900 DZD and the human-facing Ouedkniss listing ending in d56373493, not an API URL.
evidence.limitation: Price and stock are source-reported observations and must be revalidated before commitment.

evidence.claim: GET /api/admin-orders without an x-admin-token returned HTTP 401.
evidence.limitation: Correct-token access and status update still need end-to-end verification.

evidence.claim: Earlier interactive browser run verified the 8-item catalog grid, catalog add, relevant HOCO H29 search, add discovered offer, and navigation back to request section.
evidence.limitation: That run preceded final source identity deduplication. No customer data was entered and no order was submitted; repeat interaction testing was not run after the fix.

evidence.claim: Unit tests verify Ouedkniss URL variants for the same announcement normalize to one identity; static tests verify catalog and search use the shared identity utility.
evidence.limitation: Post-fix real-browser cart regression remains open.

evidence.claim: A persisted synthetic order can be created, listed by the authenticated admin API, updated through a legal state transition and re-read.
evidence.limitation: No order was submitted in the current acceptance run.

evidence.claim: The new repository is connected to a separate Vercel project; the legacy project/domain alias was not reassigned.
evidence.source: Vercel project/deployment query and post-deployment HTTP checks
evidence.limitation: The legacy production deployment and order store remain separate.

evidence.claim: A separate private Blob store is connected to the new project and the new project's health endpoint reports storage available.
evidence.source: Vercel Blob store store_rAO0bQFXBAZFzJd9 and health endpoint
evidence.limitation: Actual private order write/read/update still untested; do not migrate legacy orders without a separate plan.

evidence.claim: Payment and courier integrations are operational.
evidence.limitation: No evidence of payment gateway or shipping API integration.
